primary_population: in_scoring_domain units, separate by probe and arm

low_spike_counts.evidence: count-stratum standardization changes the imec0 gap from 0.1390 to 0.1465 and imec1 from 0.0888 to 0.1411; excluding units below 1000 spikes leaves gaps of 0.1234 and 0.0577
low_spike_counts.interpretation: low counts concentrate undefined values, but finite failures concentrate in higher-count units and the arm gap is not removed

q_state_composition.evidence: q-activity standardization leaves gaps of 0.1310 (imec0) and 0.1120 (imec1), with 100% common-stratum coverage

mixed_q_units.interpretation: the gap is not a displaced-only compositional artifact

displaced_only_units.interpretation: a same-sign gap exists, but q standardization does not reduce the headline gap and mixed-q gaps are larger

ordinary_interior_units.interpretation: the gap is not confined to scoring-domain edges

both_q0_and_displaced_failure.interpretation: persistent subset failures are common, but the A-REF difference is modest on imec0 and nearly zero on imec1; subset-histogram values are not motion-effect estimates

measurement_fitness.comparable_claim: saved pass/fail fields use a common named cutoff and threshold within this census
measurement_fitness.not_comparable_claim: full, q0, and displaced numeric cutoffs are not paired effect estimates because their histograms use different event subsets and subset-dependent support

recommendation.decision: do not attribute the noise-cutoff gap to low counts, displaced-only composition, q-state mix, or depth-edge mix on the available tables
recommendation.cheapest_repair: publish the exact executed evaluator snapshot and emit compact per-unit full/q0/displaced histogram sufficient statistics and estimator diagnostics (finite event count, binning/range, peak, occupied-tail count, high-tail count/mean/std, first-low count, cutoff margin, undefined reason)
recommendation.next_diagnostic: recompute the frozen cutoff from those compact sufficient statistics and separate estimator instability/undefined reasons from genuine low-amplitude truncation before considering raw-voltage or waveform work

limits: descriptive unit populations, not matched biological identities
no causal arm or sorter-stage attribution
no claim that noise cutoff proves physical amplitude completeness
no inference from state-specific cutoff differences to motion effects
exact field assignment and evaluator version remain provenance-qualified until the exact executed source bytes are published
